name: Lincoln Park Zoo
tagline: Free lakefront apes, Penguin Cove, then a small-clawed otter splash.

practical.ticket_note: Free admission (donations welcome) — confirm current policy on lpzoo.org.
practical.transit_note: Lincoln Park; walkable from North Side hotels; limited parking.
